posts.text:
No Super Bowl, tho


Mayor Muriel Bowser (@MayorBowser)

Over the last decade, Washington, DC has won a:

Stanley Cup (2018)
World Series (2019)
WNBA Championship (2019)
NWSL Championship (2021)
UFL Championship (2025)

On top of that, we opened Audi Field and CareFirst Arena, reached an agreement to transform Capital One Arena, and in 2030, we'll bring the Commanders back to RFK.

I’d say it’s been a good time to be Mayor of the Sports Capital.
